xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfBoardC:
As on 31.03.2025, MTNL had three Executive Directors and two Govt. Nominee Directors on its Board. As on 31.03.2025, there was no Independent Director including Women Director & Independent Women Director on the Board of MTNL. On 23.03.2025, Shri Piyush Ranjan Nishad, Independent Director ceases to be Independent Director of the Company on completion of tenure of three years. In order to comply with provisions of Regulation 17(1) & 17(1E) of SEBI (LODR) 2015, we need five Independent Directors i.e. fifty percent of the total strength as we have five directors (including three Functional and two Government Nominee Directors) including Executive Chairman. In the circumstances, MTNL needs five Independent Directors including one Women Independent Director on its Board. The matter for appointment of Independent Directors has already been taken up with the Government of India.
MTNL is complying with Regulation 17(1A), 17(1C) and 17(1D).

The Audit Committee was reconstituted on 14.11.2024 with one Independent Director and two Govt Nominee director. After cessation of Shri Piyush Ranjan Nishad as Independent Director w.e.f. 23.03.2025, there is no Independent Director remaining in the Audit Committee from 24.03.2025 till 31.03.2025.

The Nomination and Remuneration Committee was reconstituted on 14.11.2024 with one Independent Director as Chairman and two Govt Nominee Director as Members. After cessation of Shri Piyush Ranjan Nishad as Independent Director w.e.f. 23.03.2025, there is no Independent Director remaining in the Nomination & Remuneration Committee from 24.03.2025 till 31.03.2025.

xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfNonComplianceOfMeetin: On 01.11.2024, four Independent Directors completed their tenure of three years. On 23.03.2025, remaining one Independent Director also completed his tenure. As there was only one Independent Director from 02.11.2024 till 23.03.2025, no meeting of Independent Directors was held.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:DetailsOfTheViolationOrContrav: Non-Compliance with the provisions of Regulation 17(1), 18(1), 19(1)/19(2), 20(2)/(2A) and 21(2) of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:ImpactOnFinancialOrOperationOr: Total Fines of Rs. 6,93,840/- (inclusive of Basic fine amounting to Rs. 5,88,000/- and GST amounting to Rs. 1,05,840/-). Further, there is no material impact on the Financial, operation or other activities of MTNL. MTNL is also requesting to NSE and BSE for waiver of fines as all appointments including Independent Directors on the Board are made by the Administrative Ministry i.e. Department of Telecommunications (DoT), Ministry of Communications, Government of India.
